lobby.mascot.lines: Every round, you're either a hider or a seeker.
Hiders get some time at the start to find a good hiding spot.
Seekers have to find every hider before time runs out.
Once you're found, you either join the seekers or you're out.
Collect orbs and spend them on helpful items in the shop.
Click the NPC next to me to join a round. Have fun!
